columns.name: notebook_ref
columns.description: Notebook identifier, owner/slug.

columns.name: owner
columns.description: Account that owns the notebook. The team notebook is owned by prvsiyan.

columns.name: title_as_displayed
columns.description: Title as shown on the code page or in the kernel list at capture time.

columns.name: version
columns.description: Kaggle notebook version the score refers to (vN). Blank when not recorded.

columns.name: votes
columns.description: Votes at capture time (see votes_snapshot). Blank when not recorded.

columns.name: votes_snapshot
columns.description: Which capture the votes came from: scorecard 15:03 UTC or kernel list 14:42 UTC, both on 8 October 2026.

columns.name: displayed_score
columns.description: Score on the code page, rounded to three decimals by the platform. Blank when not recorded. For score_label P it is a claim, not a render.

columns.name: score_label
columns.description: V: rendered on the code page on the capture date. P: author claim, title or listing, not on the render. -: no score recorded.

columns.name: scorecard_rank
columns.description: Rank on the 8 October 15:03 UTC scorecard. Blank if the notebook is not on it.

columns.name: method_family
columns.description: Method as read from the source code, or the claim where marked P. "not opened" where the notebook was not read.

columns.name: convnext_mean_weight
columns.description: Mean weight of the goodpjw2008 ConvNeXt reader in the blend of the displayed version. Blank when that version has no ConvNeXt reader or the weight is not recorded.

columns.name: weight_origin
columns.description: Where the blend weights come from: copied between notebooks, gated on gold58, hard-coded, or set by the author.

columns.name: uses_oai_derived_checkpoint
columns.description: Whether the notebook uses the nartaa checkpoint, which the dataset description says was trained with masked supervision on OAI knees.

columns.name: uses_nc_radimagenet_component
columns.description: Whether a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 RadImageNet-derived file is attached or used. "likely" when the stack the notebook builds on is documented to include one.

columns.name: notebook_licence
columns.description: Licence shown on the rendered page, or "not read".

columns.name: licence_label
columns.description: V: licence read on the rendered page. -: not read.

columns.name: assets_itemised
columns.description: yes: every attached dataset is listed in notebook_assets.csv. partial: some are listed. no: none are listed.

columns.name: assets_note
columns.description: What is missing from notebook_assets.csv for this notebook, or how the link was established.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Verified facts, claims and caveats for the row. Evidence labels V, P and I.

columns.name: notebook_ref
columns.description: Notebook from public_notebooks.csv.

columns.name: asset_ref
columns.description: Dataset or model the notebook attaches.

columns.name: asset_type
columns.description: Kaggle dataset, or Kaggle Model (not in assets.csv).

columns.name: basis
columns.allowed_values: attachment list read, source text, inferred from survey text
columns.description: How the link was established: read from the notebook's attachment list; stated in the source text; or inferred from the survey text.

columns.name: in_assets_csv
columns.description: Whether asset_ref has a row in assets.csv.

columns.name: asset_ref
columns.description: Dataset identifier.

columns.name: owner
columns.description: Dataset owner.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Dataset title as the platform reports it.

columns.name: licence_as_listed
columns.description: Licence as the platform reports it.

columns.name: licence_normalised
columns.allowed_values: CC0-1.0, Apache-2.0, MIT, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, other, unknown
columns.description: The same licence in one vocabulary. "other" means the licence is given in the description, and "unknown" means the platform gives none.

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.description: Total size of the dataset as the platform reports it (decimal bytes).

columns.name: size_mb
columns.description: size_bytes divided by 10^6, rounded to 0.1.

columns.name: current_version
columns.description: Current version number as the platform reports it.

columns.name: last_updated_utc
columns.description: Time of the last update, as the platform reports it.

columns.name: api_kernel_count
columns.description: Number of public notebooks attaching the dataset, as the platform reports it, in the capture named in metadata_captured_utc. Blank if not reported.

columns.name: api_download_count
columns.description: Download count as the platform reports it, in the same capture. Blank if not reported.

columns.name: mounted_by_notebooks
columns.description: Number of rows in notebook_assets.csv that link this dataset to a notebook in public_notebooks.csv.

columns.name: metadata_captured_utc
columns.description: Time of the saved metadata capture that supplies this row.

columns.name: status_for_frontier
columns.description: Publisher assessment: in use, candidate, training data, or not for use, with the reason. Source-cited.

columns.name: EfficiencyRank
columns.description: Rank on the Efficiency Prize board as the board prints it. Ties leave gaps. Rows are in rank order, not score order.

columns.name: team_key
columns.description: Pseudonymous team key: "t" plus the first 10 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the trimmed team name. Blank where the board prints no name. Names are not published.

columns.name: PublicScore
columns.description: Public leaderboard score of the team entry, as the board prints it, shown to three decimals. Not the efficiency metric. The board's metric is not verified [P].

columns.name: DateSubmitted
columns.description: Submission timestamp as the board prints it, kept as printed. The board states no time zone.

columns.name: DateSubmittedISO
columns.description: DateSubmitted in ISO form (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). No time zone is implied.
